mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawler_configurations (configuration_title, configuration_description, site_preset, request_json) VALUES (#{configurationTitle}, #{configurationDescription}, #{sitePreset}, CAST(#{requestJson} AS JSON))
mapper.update: UPDATE crawler_configurations SET configuration_title = #{configurationTitle}, configuration_description = #{configurationDescription}, site_preset = #{sitePreset}, request_json = CAST(#{requestJson} AS JSON) WHERE crawler_configuration_id = #{crawlerConfigurationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawler_run_histories (crawler_configuration_id, run_status, request_json) VALUES (#{crawlerConfigurationId}, 'RUNNING', CAST(#{requestJson} AS JSON))
mapper.update: UPDATE crawler_run_histories SET run_status = 'SUCCESS', result_json = CAST(#{resultJson} AS JSON), duration_millis = #{durationMillis}, item_count = #{itemCount}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE crawler_run_history_id = #{historyId}

UPDATE crawler_run_histories
SET run_status = 'FAILURE', failure_stage = NULLIF(#{failureStage}, ''), failure_message = #{failureMessage}, duration_millis = #{durationMillis}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE crawler_run_history_id = #{historyId}
